Failure predicate, attached screenshot and printed OCR currently use separate screenshots. Printed garbled marker is not proof the predicate screenshot was fully visible; physical clipping is independently observed.

Tracking/interacting/decelerating begin user scroll and cancel coalesced follow; idle samples native latest geometry before endUserScroll. Last geo flag user=true can precede idle handler and does not prove a stuck scrolling state.

Idle re-enables following only for at-bottom or returned-to-bottom intent. Off-bottom nudge geometry explains continued non-follow; without a recorded return, forcing follow would override legitimate away intent.

oneBoundedNextDiagnosticProposal.scope: One diagnostic-only normal-signature invocation of the same seven methods×three repetitions, exact current gestures/actions/assertions and all existing invocation/test deadlines; no retries, extra drags/taps, sleeps, fallback test or narrowed acceptance.
oneBoundedNextDiagnosticProposal.loggingOnlyDelta: If separately authorized, append bounded logging to the existing native scroll-view probe/recognizer rather than adding a competing recognizer: record existing pan-recognizer state/enablement and native offset/insets/bounds, plus read-only window hit-test ancestry for the exact recorded return endpoints at existing gesture callbacks. Add an absolute origin to trace records and driver pass/action labels for clock correlation. Retain the exact image and OCR boxes/confidence from each already-performed predicate screenshot when it fails, avoiding a replacement predicate or fuzzy matching.
oneBoundedNextDiagnosticProposal.decisionGate: A failed original return with native pan engagement but unchanged/misclassified geometry would justify investigating scroll policy; absence of engagement with a captured child hit target would direct gesture routing diagnosis. Missing recipient/engagement evidence remains inconclusive. A green diagnostic never erases this hosted failure.
